Hub.metaTitle: The Hub | Startup and Innovation Cluster
Hub.metaDescription: The CSI Hub in Cuautlancingo, Puebla: industrial bays, digital fabrication, AI and applied science labs for startups, academia and industry.
Hub.overviewTitle: CERHAN II, the cluster's physical home
Hub.overviewDescription: Industrial bays fitted out as a collaboration space for startups, academia, industry and government. A meeting point to develop innovation projects in Puebla.
Hub.overviewAddress: Av. San Lorenzo Almecatla, Cuautlancingo, Puebla
Hub.imageFachadaAlt: Exterior facade of the CSI Hub bays in Cuautlancingo
Hub.spacesTitle: Infrastructure to create, prototype and scale
Hub.spacesDescription: Each space in the Hub serves a different link in the innovation process, from digital prototyping to industrial scaling.
Hub.spaceFablabDesc: Digital fabrication with 3D printing, laser cutting and electronics for rapid prototyping.
Hub.spaceAiLabDesc: Computing infrastructure for model training and applied artificial intelligence.
Hub.spaceAuditorioDesc: Venue for cluster sessions, workshops, demo days and community events.
Hub.spaceChillDesc: Informal gathering and networking area for startups, mentors and visitors.
Hub.spaceTextilDesc: Development of materials and textiles focused on innovation and sustainability.
Hub.spaceCompostajeDesc: Research and circular economy projects around organic waste.
Hub.spaceAguaDesc: Testing and development of technologies for water treatment and reuse.
Hub.spaceMaterialesDesc: Analysis and validation of materials for industry and node projects.
Hub.imageFablabAlt: FabLab workstation at the CSI Hub
Hub.imageAiLabAlt: AI and GPU lab computing station

Hub.ctaDescription: See the bays, labs and cluster community. We coordinate visits for startups, institutions, companies and media.
